scripts.deploy:dry-run: node scripts/ensure-wrangler-config.mjs && vite build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:check && npm test && npm run test:components
scripts.db:check: npm run db:format && npm run db:validate && npm run db:generate
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/ensure-wrangler-config.mjs --seed && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/ensure-wrangler-config.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file prisma/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:dev: node scripts/ensure-wrangler-config.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file prisma/seed.dev.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: node scripts/ensure-wrangler-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/ensure-wrangler-config.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:staging:full: npm run verify:secrets -- --env staging && npm run db:migrate:staging && npm run deploy:staging
scripts.deploy:production:full: npm run verify:secrets -- --env production && npm run db:migrate:production && npm run deploy:production
